# `CAP_FOCUS_VISIBLE_UNREACHED`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [Capture (`CAP_`)](README.md#domain-cap) |
| Reported by | `capture` |

## What happened

Tab navigation never reached the target; focus was set directly, so `:focus-visible` may not show.

## What to do

Make the element keyboard-focusable, or set `stateTarget`.
